agents.name: Translate a PDF keeping its layout
agents.description: Translate a PDF from a URL while preserving the original layout — formulas, figures and two-column academic typesetting stay intact, unlike ordinary translators that flatten the document. Returns a job_id; poll check_job for the download links (translated-only and bilingual side-by-side). Typically 20-60 seconds for a few pages. Powered by PDFMathTranslate (36k stars) hosted at AI NetCafé. Example — tools/call translate_pdf {"url":"<pdf-url>","target":"zh"} → poll check_job
reasons: This tool can translate a PDF document while preserving its original layout, which is ideal for documents.
uncertainties: Execution requires a fresh readiness check.
